subject: app crashing regularly on shinyapps server - not on local machine

messages.author: dc6fc8aeb418aa0a
messages.subject: app crashing regularly on shinyapps server - not on local machine
parts:
Hi!

My app is crashing frequently on shinyapps server without any distinguishable pattern.


Console output is most of the time a "pooling error":
 
Tue Jan 26 2016 11:27:01 GMT-0800 (PST): Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":1006,"reason":"Polling error (permanent)","wasClean":false}


But sometimes it is also "error http status 500": 

####APP_URL####__sockjs__/t=e94305eb6b360bd27b31fceefff0cc8c/w=bf1d67e2/s=0/086/0fr1kp50/xhr_send 500 (Internal Server Error)u._start @ sockjs-0.3.min.js:27(anonymous function) @ sockjs-0.3.min.js:27
rstudio-connect.js:371 Tue Jan 26 2016 13:36:05 GMT-0800 (PST): Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":1006,"reason":"Sending error http status 500","wasClean":false}
 
 Tue Jan 26 2016 13:36:05 GMT-0800 (PST): Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":1006,"reason":"Sending error http status 500","wasClean":false}


 It is not due to memory or CPU usage, neither on the standard logout time (which is 15 minutes for my app, but the problem occurs way before that).

Thanks a lot in advance,
Gratien
